```{=html}
<script>
  // Append an automatic "(N)" tally to the Preprints and Published Articles
  // headers. Each header spans two listing divs, so we sum entries across both.
  // Year sub-headings (h3.pub-year-header) are not entries, so they're excluded.
  (function () {
    // Quarto puts the section id on the <section>, and prefixes listing div
    // ids with "listing-". We target the <h2> inside the section, and look up
    // the listing divs by their real (prefixed) ids.
    var sections = [
      { sectionId: 'sec-preprints', divIds: ['listing-in-review', 'listing-preprints'] },
      { sectionId: 'sec-published', divIds: ['listing-in-press', 'listing-published-articles'] }
    ];

    function countEntries(divId) {
      var div = document.getElementById(divId);
      if (!div) return 0;
      // Listing entries are <li> inside ul.list; year headers are <h3>, not <li>
      return div.querySelectorAll('ul.list > li').length;
    }

    function addTallies() {
      var allDone = true;
      sections.forEach(function (s) {
        var section = document.getElementById(s.sectionId);
        if (!section) return;
        var header = section.querySelector('h2');
        if (!header || header.dataset.tallied) return;
        var total = s.divIds.reduce(function (sum, id) {
          return sum + countEntries(id);
        }, 0);
        if (total === 0) { allDone = false; return; } // not rendered yet; retry
        var span = document.createElement('span');
        span.className = 'section-count';
        span.style.fontWeight = '400';
        span.style.color = '#6c757d';
        span.textContent = ' (' + total + ')';
        header.appendChild(span);
        header.dataset.tallied = 'true';
      });
      return allDone;
    }

    // Poll until the listings have populated (up to ~5s), instead of guessing a
    // single delay. Quarto renders listing entries via JS after DOMContentLoaded.
    function start() {
      var tries = 0;
      var timer = setInterval(function () {
        tries++;
        if (addTallies() || tries > 50) clearInterval(timer);
      }, 100);
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', start);
    } else {
      start();
    }
  })();
</script>
```
